title: DISPOSITION v1 dispose response
description: internal/server/disposition.DisposeResponse. One result per disposed item -- more than one only when the request named a group_id, each member disposed individually, never as one bulk write.

already_disposed.description: True when the item was already disposed before this call; item carries the recorded verdict, not this request's.

replayed.description: True when idempotency_key matched a prior successful call; item is the original result, byte-identical.
